angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 578,822 km at 188.88 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.2943 +/- 0.0180 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 188.88 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.832 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Gill et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of NGTS-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract): 578,822 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.862 +/- 0.028 solar masses from Gill et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of NGTS-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5050 +/- 80 K from Gill et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of NGTS-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gill et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of NGTS-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/ngts-11.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.533, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of NGTS-11 (pscomppars): spectral type K, from Gill et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of NGTS-11 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.22 dex, from Gill et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of NGTS-11 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.39518, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of NGTS-11 (pscomppars): age 3.9 Gyr, from Gill et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of NGTS-11 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.1 km/s, from Gill et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020ApJ...898L..11G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
